title: Add and fill a column
prompt: Add a column named rating of type INTEGER to trails, and set it to 5 for every trail in the North region.

check.sql: SELECT id, rating FROM trails ORDER BY id;

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM trails; INSERT INTO trails VALUES (7, 'Birch Walk', 'West', 3.1, 40), (8, 'High Moor', 'East', 12.6, 610), (9, 'Crag Top', 'North', 6.0, 900);

solutions: ALTER TABLE trails ADD COLUMN rating INTEGER; UPDATE trails SET rating = 5 WHERE region = 'North';

wrongSolutions.sql: ALTER TABLE trails ADD COLUMN rating INTEGER;
ALTER TABLE trails ADD COLUMN rating INTEGER; UPDATE trails SET rating = 5;

title: Safe table
prompt: Create a table named badges with id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), and title TEXT NOT NULL.

check.sql: SELECT i.name, i."notnull", i.pk, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_foreign_key_list('badges')) AS foreign_keys FROM pragma_table_info('badges') i ORDER BY i.cid;

solutions: CREATE TABLE badges (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), title TEXT NOT NULL);

wrongSolutions.sql: CREATE TABLE badges (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id), title TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE badges (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL);

title: Report as a view
prompt: Create a view named customer_orders with each customer's name and their order count as orders, including customers with none.
hints: A LEFT JOIN inside a view.

check.sql: SELECT name, orders FROM customer_orders ORDER BY name;

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM order_items; DELETE FROM orders; DELETE FROM products; DELETE FROM customers; INSERT INTO customers VALUES (7, 'Ravi', 'Oslo', 'ravi@mail.test', '2024-05-05'), (8, 'Sara', 'Lima', NULL, '2024-06-06'), (9, 'Tom', 'Oslo', NULL, '2024-07-07'); INSERT INTO products VALUES (7, 'Stool', 'Home', 40.0, 25.0), (8, 'Cup', 'Kitchen', 9.0, 2.0), (9, 'Ink', 'Stationery', 12.5, 6.0); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (11, 7, '2024-02-28', 'shipped'), (12, 8, '2024-03-01', 'pending'), (13, 7, '2024-03-31', 'cancelled'); INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (11, 7, 1, 4.0), (11, 8, 3, NULL), (12, 9, 2, NULL), (13, 8, 1, NULL);

solutions: CREATE VIEW customer_orders AS SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS orders FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name;

wrongSolutions.sql: CREATE VIEW customer_orders AS SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS orders FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name;
CREATE VIEW customer_orders AS SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name;

title: Index the lookups
prompt: Add an index named idx_items_order on order_items (order_id) and another named idx_items_product on order_items (product_id).

check.sql: SELECT i.name, c.name AS column_name FROM pragma_index_list('order_items') i, pragma_index_info(i.name) c ORDER BY i.name;

solutions: CREATE INDEX idx_items_order ON order_items (order_id); CREATE INDEX idx_items_product ON order_items (product_id);

wrongSolutions.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_items_order ON order_items (order_id, product_id);

title: Invite depth
prompt: Show each username reachable from users with no referrer, and their invite depth as depth, with those users at 0.
solutions: WITH RECURSIVE t AS (SELECT id, username, 0 AS depth FROM users WHERE referrer_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT u.id, u.username, t.depth + 1 FROM users u JOIN t ON u.referrer_id = t.id) SELECT username, depth FROM t;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT username, 0 AS depth FROM users;

WITH RECURSIVE t AS (SELECT id, username, 0 AS depth FROM users WHERE referrer_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT u.id, u.username, t.depth FROM users u JOIN t ON u.referrer_id = t.id) SELECT username, depth FROM t;
